title: Amoré Italian Steak and Seafood: Wing Wednesday - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Solarczyk Jessica Williams ,
8 hours ago Living Local 15 Host Jessica Williams visits Amoré Italian Steak and Seafood and speaks with their General Manager, Brandon Pavey, as he highlights their Tuesday $5 Kid’s Meals, when you purchase an adult entree. Plus, we learn about their Wing Wednesday special, where you get Amore Sticky Wings and a 16 oz Draft Beer for $18, from 4-9 pm. Amoré Italian Steak and Seafood is located at 239 Pearl Street in Fort Wayne. Learn more at amorefw.com or call 260-363-0202. Read full article
